title: C¹ regularity and tangential derivative of the angle–radius profile φ(arctan(⟨y,e⟩/⟨y,u⟩))·λ(‖y‖)
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ, all u, e, x ∈ ℝ^P with ⟨x,u⟩ > 0, and all C¹ functions φ, λ : ℝ → ℝ, the function F : ℝ^P → ℝ, F(y) := φ(arctan(⟨y,e⟩/⟨y,u⟩))·λ(‖y‖), is C¹ at x, and for every h ∈ ℝ^P with ⟨x,h⟩ = 0 its Fréchet derivative satisfies DF(x)h = φ′(arctan(⟨x,e⟩/⟨x,u⟩))·λ(‖x‖)·(⟨x,u⟩⟨h,e⟩ − ⟨x,e⟩⟨h,u⟩)/(⟨x,u⟩² + ⟨x,e⟩²), where φ′ is the derivative of φ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (u e x : Euclid P) (φ lam : ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → ContDiff ℝ 1 lam → 0 < inner ℝ x u → ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y : Euclid P => φ (Real.arctan (inner ℝ y e / inner ℝ y u)) * lam ‖y‖) x ∧ ∀ h : Euclid P, inner ℝ x h = 0 → fderiv ℝ (fun y : Euclid P => φ (Real.arctan (inner ℝ y e / inner ℝ y u)) * lam ‖y‖) x h = deriv φ (Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x u)) * lam ‖x‖ * ((inner ℝ x u * inner ℝ h e - inner ℝ x e * inner ℝ h u) / (inner ℝ x u ^ 2 + inner ℝ x e ^ 2))
